parameters.content:
## W14 Weekly reports (analytics-reporter; words and shape by broker-success)
Generate 23:00 daily: one `broker_report/1` payload per live adviser from `facts.w14_broker_report()` (analytics/W14-broker-payload.sql). A weekly is only kept when the send day is a Monday; day-15 and cycle-end editions are kept on their own day. `facts.w14_hold()` (reconcile + banned-word check) decides: any failure = HELD, nothing is sent, ops alert. Passed payloads are stored in `report_history.report_data` (the portal's `reports.payload_json`, per console-portal.md).
Send 07:00: WhatsApp template (`broker_weekly`, `broker_weekly_noask`, `broker_midcycle`, `broker_cycle_end`) built from `payload.wa`, aggregates only, no lead names (POPIA). Email (howzit@, HTML + PDF) is queued as an `ops.notifications` row (payload.builder = scripts/build-broker-report-email.mjs: renders the email HTML + A4 print HTML from report_history.report_data, initials only, tokens from brand/tokens.css; headless Chromium prints the PDF; the sender attaches it and sends via Graph from howzit@).
Sunday 23:00: Lead Velocity weekly (`facts.w14_lv_payload()`), stored as `lv_weekly`; the Monday 06:00 memo (W32) delivers it.
Credentials by name; no secrets; exported inactive.

parameters.query:
with live as (
  select b.id as broker_id from public.brokers b
   where b.brand_id is not null and b.status = 'active'
     and exists (select 1 from public.cycles c where c.broker_id = b.id and c.status in ('active','extended'))
), p as (
  select l.broker_id, facts.w14_broker_report(l.broker_id) as payload from live l
)
select p.broker_id::text as broker_id, p.payload,
       p.payload ->> 'edition' as edition,
       (p.payload ->> 'error') is not null as errored,
       case when (p.payload ->> 'error') is null then facts.w14_hold(p.broker_id, p.payload) else true end as hold,
       case when (p.payload ->> 'error') is null then
         (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(r.check_name), '[]'::jsonb) from facts.w14_reconcile(p.broker_id, p.payload) r where not r.ok)
       else jsonb_build_array(p.payload ->> 'error') end as failed_checks,
       ((now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date + 1) as send_date,
       to_char((now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date + 1, 'ID')::int = 1 as send_is_monday
from p;

parameters.jsCode:
// A weekly is kept only when the send day is a Monday. Day-15 and cycle-end editions are kept on their own day (they replace the weekly that morning).
return $input.all().filter((i) => i.json.edition !== 'weekly' || i.json.send_is_monday);

insert into public.report_history (status, brand_id, broker_id, cycle_id, week, report_kind, report_data, ask, judge_passed, edition)
select 'generated', (select id from public.brands where code = 'SMC'), $1::uuid, ($2::jsonb #>> '{cycle,id}')::uuid, $3::date,
       case $4 when 'weekly' then 'broker_weekly' else $4 end, $2::jsonb, $2::jsonb #>> '{s7_ask,code}', true, $4
on conflict (broker_id, week, report_kind) where brand_id is not null
do update set report_data = excluded.report_data, ask = excluded.ask, judge_passed = true, status = 'generated', updated_at = now()
 where public.report_history.sent_wa_at is null
returning id::text as report_id, broker_id::text, report_kind, edition, ask;

with h as (
  insert into public.report_history (status, brand_id, broker_id, cycle_id, week, report_kind, report_data, judge_passed, edition)
  select 'held', (select id from public.brands where code = 'SMC'), $1::uuid, ($2::jsonb #>> '{cycle,id}')::uuid, $3::date,
         case $4 when 'weekly' then 'broker_weekly' else $4 end,
         coalesce($2::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('judge', jsonb_build_object('pass', false, 'failed', $5::jsonb)), false, $4
  on conflict (broker_id, week, report_kind) where brand_id is not null
  do update set status = 'held', judge_passed = false, report_data = excluded.report_data, updated_at = now() where public.report_history.sent_wa_at is null
  returning id
)
insert into ops.notifications (kind, recipient, channel, dedupe_key, payload, severity, what, first_action)
select 'action', 'jonathan', 'console', 'w14-held-' || $1 || '-' || $3, jsonb_build_object('failed_checks', $5::jsonb, 'broker_id', $1), 'amber',
       'A broker report was held and not sent', 'Open the report in the console, fix the failing check, then re-run W14 for this adviser'
where not exists (select 1 from ops.notifications where dedupe_key = 'w14-held-' || $1 || '-' || $3)
returning id;

select rh.id::text as report_id, rh.broker_id::text as broker_id, rh.cycle_id::text as cycle_id, rh.edition, rh.report_data as payload,
       regexp_replace(coalesce(br.whatsapp_number, ''), '\D', '', 'g') as wa_to
  from public.report_history rh join public.brokers br on br.id = rh.broker_id
 where rh.brand_id is not null and rh.status = 'generated' and rh.judge_passed and rh.sent_wa_at is null
   and rh.report_kind in ('broker_weekly','midcycle','cycle_end') and rh.created_at > now() - interval '36 hours'
   and br.status = 'active' and br.whatsapp_number is not null;

insert into public.report_history (status, brand_id, week, report_kind, report_data)
select 'generated', (select id from public.brands where code = 'SMC'), date_trunc('week', (now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date + 1)::date, 'lv_weekly', $1::jsonb
where not exists (select 1 from public.report_history where report_kind = 'lv_weekly' and week = date_trunc('week', (now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date + 1)::date)
returning id::text as report_id;

// DRY_RUN_SENDS=true: nothing leaves the box (whatsapp). Pass the input on with a fake 2xx so downstream logging still runs.
return $input.all().map((i, n) => ({ json: { ...i.json, dry_run: true, statusCode: 200, body: { messages: [{ id: 'dry:' + n }] } } }));

parameters.query:
-- I-36c: consume the ops.notifications email rows W14 queued ("Mark sent and queue email"). Claim = attempts+1 under SKIP LOCKED, so two ticks never take the same row;
-- backoff = n * 15 min between tries, at most 3 tries (no retry storm). Rows with no broker email, or not queued by W14, are never touched.
with c as (
  update ops.notifications n set attempts = n.attempts + 1, updated_at = now()
   where n.id in (
     select x.id from ops.notifications x
      where x.source = 'W14' and x.channel = 'email' and x.sent_at is null
        and coalesce(x.status, 'queued') = 'queued' and x.attempts < 3
        and (x.attempts = 0 or x.updated_at < now() - (x.attempts * interval '15 minutes'))
      order by x.created_at limit 20 for update skip locked)
  returning n.id, n.payload, n.attempts
)
select c.id as notification_id, c.attempts, c.payload, rh.id as report_id, rh.brand_id, rh.broker_id, rh.report_data, b.email as broker_email
  from c
  join public.report_history rh on rh.id = (c.payload->>'report_id')::uuid
  left join public.brokers b on b.id = rh.broker_id;

parameters.query:
-- I-36c disclosure/delivery evidence: one communications row per report email. DRY_RUN rows are marked (external_id 'dry:...', metadata.dry_run) and leave the queue row queued with its attempt given back,
-- so switching DRY_RUN off later still sends it. A real send closes the queue row. The PDF itself is not stored (initials only, regenerated from report_history).
with u as (
  update ops.notifications n set
         status = case when $6::boolean then n.status else 'sent' end,
         sent_at = case when $6::boolean then null else now() end,
         attempts = case when $6::boolean then greatest(n.attempts - 1, 0) else n.attempts end,
         external_id = case when $6::boolean then null else 'email:' || n.id end,
         error = null, updated_at = now()
   where n.id = $1::uuid and n.sent_at is null
  returning n.id
)
insert into public.communications (brand_id, channel, direction, sender_type, recipient_type, recipient_contact, subject, content, status, external_id, broker_id, author, workflow, template_name, metadata)
select $2::uuid, 'email', 'outbound', 'system', 'broker', $3, $4, 'Weekly report email with PDF attached (initials only): ' || $5, 'sent',
       case when $6::boolean then 'dry:email:' else 'email:' end || u.id, $7::uuid, 'system', 'W14', 'broker_report_email', jsonb_build_object('report_id', $8::text, 'dry_run', $6::boolean, 'pdf', 'initials_only')
  from u
on conflict (channel, external_id) where brand_id is not null and external_id is not null do nothing;

-- Failure keeps the row queued for the next backoff slot; after the 3rd failed try it is closed as send_failed and Jonathan gets one amber console item (never a retry storm).
with u as (
  update ops.notifications n set error = left($2, 300), status = case when n.attempts >= 3 then 'send_failed' else n.status end, updated_at = now()
   where n.id = $1::uuid and n.sent_at is null
  returning n.id, n.attempts, n.status
)
insert into ops.notifications (kind, recipient, channel, dedupe_key, payload, severity, source, what, first_action)
select 'action', 'jonathan', 'console', 'w14-email-failed-' || u.id, jsonb_build_object('notification_id', u.id, 'error', left($2, 300)), 'amber', 'W14',
       'A broker report email did not send (3 tries)', 'Check the howzit@ credential health tile, then re-send the report from the console'
  from u where u.status = 'send_failed' and not exists (select 1 from ops.notifications where dedupe_key = 'w14-email-failed-' || u.id)
returning id;
